dialogue.line: I wonder why my investigation notebook has two colors, black and white
Aurora? Is that you? My connection is finally recovered. I've landed safely
And have you looked at your handbook?
Just a little bit. The colors confuse me. Any meaning behind it?
The white and black? Those are for different content, by design.
You see, the Agency have been monitoring this civilization for years, but all of a sudden it collapses into ashes.
The only thing captured is this photo, this black and white photo.
We worked for years to get it, now it is the time to find the truth.
This communication will be kept active, if any future studies you would like to reference from the Agency.
